physicalNotes: Radius 0.22035902 Jupiter radii from Barkaoui et al. 2023 (2023A&A...677A..38B), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023A&A...677A..38B/abstract): 15,753.9 km at 71,492 km per Jupiter radius. GM from the mass 0.021 Jupiter masses (the NASA Exoplanet Archive's calculated value (M-R relationship, its Chen & Kipping 2017 mass-radius relationship): a model, not a measurement, via the NASA Exoplanet Archive, https://exoplanetarchive.ipac.caltech.edu/docs/pscp_calc.html) times JPL's Jupiter GM. A sphere: no oblateness is measured.

sources.orientation: Display convention: transit photometry does not measure the orbit's position angle on the sky, so the ascending node is set at position angle 0 (celestial north).
